messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick ask — we're finalizing the launch blog + webinar narrative and need a small, defensible bench sanity pack from runtime. Can you run the smoke protocol below and confirm numbers?

zoe_marketing: Requirements: 1) 1k sample cohort (random stratified by token length: 0-64,65-256,257-1024), 2) quantized (int8) + fp16 variants, 3) coldstart + warmed cache (single-shot then 5-request warmup), 4) embed and generate endpoints. Need percentile latency (p50/p95/p99), tokens/sec, and cost-estimate per 1M tokens.

zoe_marketing: Acceptance: differences across runs <=10% for p95 and ops stable (no OOMs). If larger variance, note suspected cause.

zoe_marketing: Deliverables: small csv with columns [variant, cohort_slice, run_type, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tps, est_cost_per_1M_tokens], a short bullet summary + 1 synthetic sample trace for the demo. ETA by EOD Fri?

raj_runtime: Thanks — can do. Two clarifying q's: (1) do you want the exact customers' payloads or anonymized synthetic? (2) which model flavor in the catalog should we target for the launch numbers (redwood-v1-small / redwood-v1-base / other)?

zoe_marketing: anonymized synthetic is fine — use sampled real inputs with redaction. Target model: redwood-v1-base for headline numbers + redwood-v1-quantized (int8) for cost calls-out. If runtime team thinks a slightly different variant better represents production, flag it in notes.

lina_eng-runtime: We'll run in the staging cluster with the standard workload injector. Quick note: staging has slightly different GPU mix (A10g vs prod A100p). We'll add a short correction table to map perf delta. Also, for coldstart we will restart the pod for each run — is that expected?

zoe_marketing: Yes, coldstart = clean pod, no cache. Warm = single warmup sequence of 5 representative requests per worker. Include both.

raj_runtime: Plan: 3 rounds per variant (coldstart, warm, warm+batching) across 3 token buckets. We'll attach raw traces and an aggregated csv. If p95 variance >10% we'll capture heatmap of seq len vs latency. ETA Friday 18:00 PT.

mateo_product: Heads-up — for the webinar slide we want a single callout comparing redwood-v1-base int8 vs fp16 p95 for 256-token median payload. If you can include micro-run numbers for that exact slice that'd be great.

drew_growth: Also, can you include a short sentence we can paste into PR: "Measured on staging with stratified random inputs; numbers reflect median of 3 runs; see raw traces for details."

raj_runtime: Noted. We'll add the exact line and attach the trace bundle link.

lina_eng-runtime: One more: will marketing need the warmup script we used (so you can reproduce on demand)? We can include the runner config and the warmup payload list.

zoe_marketing: Yes please — include runner config and the seed list. We'll pin them in the blog repo.

devops-bot: Deploy bot: scheduled job created — bench-pack-1755557777 queued on staging-cluster at 2025-03-18T09:02:00Z. Job id: bench-1755557777.

raj_runtime: Starting run now (bench-1755557777). Will post interim summary when coldstart round completes.

lina_eng-runtime: Coldstart round finished: preliminary p95s for redwood-v1-base(fp16) = 210ms(0-64), 340ms(65-256), 880ms(257-1024). Attaching raw. Variance across 3 repeats within ~7%.

zoe_marketing: Awesome — thanks for the quick turn. Please keep the raw traces and summary in the shared folder and tag me when done.

raj_runtime: Final bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-staging/bench-1755557777/bundle.zip. CSV + runner-config + warmup-list included. Short summary: overall p95 delta int8 vs fp16 ~12% reduction in p95 for int8 on 65-256 slice; cost estimate ~0.88x. Note: staging GPU difference likely underestimates prod improvement.

zoe_marketing: Great, we'll use the numbers with a footnote about staging GPU. Can you paste the one-line PR blurb and the exact runner-config snippet here?

raj_runtime: PR blurb: "Performance measured on staging (A10g) with stratified anonymized inputs; reported numbers are medians of 3 runs — see attached traces for full reproducibility."

raj_runtime: Runner-config snippet:
```
{
  "workers": 8,
  "batching": { "max_tokens": 2048, "max_batch_size": 32 },
  "warmup": { "per_worker": 5, "payload_seed": "bench-1755557777-seedlist" }
}
```

zoe_marketing: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll draft the blog copy using the CSV and tag you for final sign-off tomorrow. :rocket:
